goal: Collect actual licensed Workshop staging provenance through a separately gated fixed two-file adapter.
acceptance_tests: Actual enrolled Bankone and Banktwo population has nonempty frozen denominators and independently measured 1.0 fast-lane provenance coverage.
Protected immutable source/object versions, rights and required field/locator evidence bind to exact candidate.
Failed, pending, quarantined and withdrawn required outcomes remain in the denominator.
Synthetic, stale, dropped or cross-candidate evidence cannot satisfy staging acceptance.
A separate synchronized gate and preflight precede implementation after real enrollment selection.
forbidden_scope: Changing the autonomy policy or weakening required checks
Publishing secrets or private source payloads
Editing paths outside the assigned scope
Changing the requested gpt-6.1-sol / medium / Fast execution profile or silently falling back to another model or tier

compatibility.api: Preserve existing consumers with additive versioned fields; run compatibility checks.
compatibility.events: Preserve event identity and make duplicate delivery idempotent.
compatibility.schema: Forward-only additive migrations with clean and upgrade verification; no destructive edits to historical migrations.
